about.label: About the documentary
about.title: En todas las canchas somos Argentina
body: A short documentary portraying Argentine identity outside Argentina, with the 2026 FIFA World Cup as its backdrop and Barcelona as its stage.

Through the Filial Argentina, its supporters' groups and its people, we explore the life of the emigrant, the sense of belonging and football as a collective expression of an identity that transcends borders.
Because the pitch is much more than a field: it is a way of life.

director.label: The director's vision
director.body: Surrendering to the process, where reality becomes the stage. There is no fiction. A place where the present is found. One that speaks for itself. There is no need to direct; there is intention, but it resolves itself in finding what is truly yours, which comes to you when the search is honest. That is <0>En todas las canchas somos Argentina</0>. Calling it a short film limits it; it is much more than a format, more than a story. It is the reality and present of a people, of immigration, culture and identity, a place that takes on an almost religious nuance, the devotion of a country that lives with hope and faith in its blood. Not only through a sport, but in life as a whole. Grateful to have captured much more than an audiovisual piece: an identity proud of itself.

filial.label: The people who made this story possible
filial.name: Diego Justo
filial.quote: The Filial is much more than a group of fans. It's a family, a meeting place, a support network and a piece of Argentina in Barcelona.
filial.body: Diego Justo, founder and leading figure of Filial Argentina, tells how the idea for this project was born, the work of the community and what it means to keep the albiceleste passion alive from afar.
